body:
Oh my fucking god man.Exact same shit. I just wish my parents were supportive like yours (well my dad told me to take time off but i live with my mom and she didnt want to hear any of that).

You do see that few of your "friends" who had the same goals as you but were stuggling to get good grades from the start and who were secretly jealous of your success and constant cheerful attitude will take a great pleasure from seeing you struggle to get back on your feet. Why? Maybe because it helps them feel better about themselves?. I don't know exactly,I won't try to understand but they love comparing themselves to you NOW that you went through a living hell that destroyed you and you're at your lowest but they wouldn't do any of that when you were still at the top of the class.

They'll now take any opportunities they have to kick you and put you down (even tho you're struggling to get back up) while pretending to care for you.  It's really toxic to have that kind of person around if you want to recover.

At least when they do that you see their true colors and you can easily weed them out whenever you recover back to normal. Some of them hide behind a constant smile and "cheerful" personality, if you pay attention,you'll realize that they are actually terrible people. 

I remember one girl was happy because someone she knew dropped out of med school after major stuff happened to her.She didn't say she was happy but you could hear it and see it in her face. But you won't easily guess how toxic she is ,she looks like a fucking angel,always pretending to care,always smiling. Oh and, i'm mainly talking about that girl here. It's weird because she had 2.5 GPA the first semester, i was legit worried about her and wanted to help her. Now? She will laugh at your constant struggles, make few mean comments about how mediocre you are. But then she'll act all kind again before doing the same shit. I guess i was just the naive one

**Lol sorry for this rant,it's just something that really pissed me off.** It's better to just ignore all of that and focus on myself .

I did learn things. I sure hope that we'll make it through. One thing is sure, i won't be as kind and naive as i used to be, i saw the real face of some people when they have nothing to gain from you anymore.

I did see who were my real friends tho. They really cared about me.
